title: Apron SLAM qualification and unclosed gates
summary: Synthetic ooRexx regression qualification only. No validated real plate-reading probability or independently surveyed camera calibration.
invariants: Synthetic perfect-fit regression does not validate camera calibration from a real fixed camera.
Residual rankings are not probabilities and may not be described as match likelihoods.
The initial reference glyph experiments depend on permitted local non-distributed font usage; no generated face/plate/source images are published.
Canonical MathsBootstrap runtime linkage, rolling shutter, optical distortion, MP4 access-unit seek qualification and real labelled ground-truth character recall remain open.
No Gopher runtime sphere registration is claimed from a Git folder alone.
procedure: Run all native ooRexx Apron SLAM synthetic test groups under the r13196 interpreter.
Independently run static Gopher pack cross-reference tests and document the branch/SHA tested.
Qualify MathsBootstrap dependency with the complete accepted Maths source and pin that revision.
Calibrate camera intrinsics and physical road anchors before evaluating plate-character recall on controlled consenting footage.
